create_orion_for_causal_lm: create an OrionForCausalLM model instance for inference-only Orion-14B with HuggingFace weights
build_orion_model: build an OrionModel with embedding tokens, decoder layers, and normalization for parallel processing
build_orion_decoder_layer: build an OrionDecoderLayer with self-attention and MLP using config and layer id

load_orion_weights: load HuggingFace weights into OrionForCausalLM with support for stacked qkv and gate_up parameter sharding
